metadata.name: LiteLLM
metadata.summary: One proxy for many LLM providers, with keys, models and spend kept in PostgreSQL.

zh-CN.summary: LiteLLM 以 UID 65534 运行，根文件系统只读，没有服务账号令牌，多余的权限都去掉了。对外连接没有限制。每个 API 调用都要带主密钥，或由主密钥发出的密钥。

zh-TW.summary: LiteLLM 以 UID 65534 執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有服務帳號權杖，多餘的權限都拿掉了。對外連線沒有限制。每個 API 呼叫都要帶主金鑰，或由主金鑰發出的金鑰。

zh-CN.mitigation: 主密钥只留给管理用。给应用使用的，请发出有预算和模型限制的虚拟密钥。
zh-CN.risk: 主密钥可以完整访问代理、代理发出的密钥，以及它保存的服务商凭证。

zh-TW.mitigation: 主金鑰只留給管理用。給應用程式使用的，請發出有預算和模型限制的虛擬金鑰。
zh-TW.risk: 主金鑰可以完整存取代理、代理發出的金鑰，以及它保存的服務商認證資訊。

risks.mitigation: Keep the master key for administration only. Give applications virtual keys with budgets and model limits.
risks.risk: The master key gives full access to the proxy, to its keys and to the provider credentials it stores.

zh-CN.risk: 企业版功能需要 BerriAI 的许可。

zh-TW.mitigation: 範本沒有設定 LITELLM_LICENSE，所以企業版功能是關閉的。因為企業版程式碼包含在映像檔裡，安裝範本的人必須接受企業版授權。
zh-TW.risk: 企業版功能需要 BerriAI 的授權。

risks.mitigation: No LITELLM_LICENSE is set, so enterprise features stay off. Because the enterprise code ships in the image, the person who installs the template must accept the enterprise license.
risks.risk: Enterprise features need a license from BerriAI.

zh-CN.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个集群创建对应的 RBAC 权限。LiteLLM 的 Pod 没有令牌。
zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的数据库实例会用 operator 创建的身份调用 Kubernetes API。

zh-TW.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個叢集建立對應的 RBAC 權限。LiteLLM 的 Pod 沒有權杖。
zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的資料庫實例會用 operator 建立的身分呼叫 Kubernetes API。

risks.mitigation: The cloudnative-pg component creates the RBAC permissions for each cluster. The LiteLLM Pod has no token.
risks.risk: The CloudNativePG database instances call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the operator creates.

security.summary: LiteLLM runs as UID 65534 with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and all extra capabilities dropped. Outbound traffic is not limited. Every API call needs the master key or a key that the master key issued.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: litellm
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: litellm
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: litellm
        app.kubernetes.io/name: litellm
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 65534
        runAsGroup: 65534
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: litellm
        image: ghcr.io/berriai/litellm-non_root:v1.106.3@sha256:4fe2270c8b66d25654514744ee6629445c255c0303c292fcbd2d973117a04207
        args: [--port, '4000']
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 4000
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 2Gi
        env:
        - name: MASTER_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: litellm-secrets
              key: master-key
        - name: LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
          value: sk-$(MASTER_KEY)
        - name: LITELLM_SALT_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: litellm-secrets
              key: salt-key
        - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: litellm-db-app
              key: password
        # Prisma takes the CA as sslcert; sslaccept=strict verifies it.
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          value: postgresql://litellm:$(DATABASE_PASSWORD)@litellm-db-rw:5432/litellm?sslmode=require&sslcert=/db-ca/ca.crt&sslaccept=strict
        - name: STORE_MODEL_IN_DB
          value: 'True'
        - name: LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP
          value: 'True'
        - name: LITELLM_MIGRATION_DIR
          value: /var/lib/litellm/migrations
        - name: UI_USERNAME
          value: admin
        volumeMounts:
        - name: db-ca
          mountPath: /db-ca
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: cache
          mountPath: /app/.cache
        - name: runtime
          mountPath: /var/lib/litellm/ui
          subPath: ui
        - name: runtime
          mountPath: /var/lib/litellm/assets
          subPath: assets
        - name: runtime
          mountPath: /var/lib/litellm/migrations
          subPath: migrations
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/liveliness
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/readiness
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/liveliness
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: db-ca
        secret:
          secretName: litellm-db-ca
          items:
          - {key: ca.crt, path: ca.crt}
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      - name: cache
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
      - name: runtime
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: litellm
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: litellm
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 4000
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: litellm
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: litellm-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: litellm
            port:
              number: 4000
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: litellm-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: litellm
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:18-minimal-trixie@sha256:0675340b02be838319b9b6f323c206693e519dcd62ec729d539be9f46bb7a2f9
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: litellm
      owner: litellm
      encoding: UTF8
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: '1'
      memory: 1Gi
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: 128MB
      max_connections: '100'
